delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/activities/{id}/recordings/{recording_id}` — remove (detach) a
recording from an activity.
delete.description:
The recording is **not** deleted: it is split into its own new
single-recording activity (a durable manual split). Both the trimmed
original and the new activity are marked `user_confirmed`, so re-importing or
re-running clustering will not auto-merge them back
([`ofit_db::Db::detach_recording_from_activity`]).

On success returns **200** with the *updated* (re-resolved) detail of the
activity the recording was removed from — so the remove UI can refresh
in place (the per-metric source view is recomputed, since one contributing
source is now gone). The newly created activity id is also returned.

Guards (return **400**, no-op): the recording is not a member of the
activity, or it is the activity's *only* recording (removing it would leave
an empty activity).

400.description: recording is not a member, or is the only recording

`POST /api/auth/setup` — create the first account (only when none exists),
then log in. 409 if an account already exists.

get.summary: `GET /api/auth/status` — whether the first-run wizard should run.

post.summary: `POST /api/import` — multipart upload; import each part via the pipeline.

put.summary: `PUT /api/preferences` — set a default or per-activity preference.
put.description:
Retroactive semantics: when a retroactive *default* is set
([`ofit_core::should_reresolve_history`]), the resolved view of historical
activities reflects it immediately (resolution is computed at read time from
the stored preferences), which is exactly what the dashboard re-renders.

ActivityDetail.description: Activity detail: contributing recordings + the resolved (merged) view.

recordings.description: The recordings that make up this activity.

resolved_metrics.description: Resolved scalar metrics (one per kind, best source), chart-ready.

track.description: The resolved LatLng track for the map (best source), downsampled.

track_source_id.description: Source of the resolved track, if any.

ActivitySummary.description: One row in the activities list.

duration_secs.description: Duration of the activity window in seconds.

recording_count.description: How many raw recordings make up this activity.

Health.description:
Liveness payload. Reports the DB backend in use so the simple/full tier is
visible at a glance.

ImportFileResult.description: Outcome of importing a single uploaded file.

activity_id.description: The activity the recording was clustered into (absent on duplicate/error).

deduped.description: True when the exact bytes were already present (content-hash match).

filename.description: Original filename from the multipart part.

recording_id.description: The persisted (or pre-existing) recording id, when known.

ImportResponse.description: Response of `POST /api/import` — one result per uploaded part.

PreferenceDto.description: A metric→source preference as exposed to the client.

source_id.description: Chosen source for this metric in this scope.

RecordingDto.description: A contributing recording within an activity detail view.

format.description: File format (`fit` / `gpx` / `tcx`) from ingest metadata, if known.

source_id.description: Id of the source it came from.

RemoveRecordingResponse.description:
Response of `DELETE /api/activities/{id}/recordings/{recording_id}`.

Carries the re-resolved detail of the activity the recording was removed
from (so the UI refreshes in place) plus the id of the new single-recording
activity the detached recording now lives in.

activity.description: The updated (re-resolved) activity the recording was removed from.

detached_activity_id.description:
Id of the new single-recording activity that now owns the detached
recording (the durable manual split).

ResolvedScalarMetric.description: A resolved scalar metric (best source per kind), downsampled for charts.

recording_id.description: Recording the chosen stream came from.

selected_by.description: Why this source was selected (override / default / priority).

source_name.description: Source name (for the per-metric picker UI).

ScalarPoint.description: A scalar sample point, ready for charting (`[x, y]`-ish, but named).

SelectionReason.description:
Why a particular source was chosen for a metric — useful for the UI to show
whether a choice is an explicit preference or a fallback.

SetPreferenceRequest.description: Body of `PUT /api/preferences` — set a default or per-activity preference.

metric.description: Metric to pin a source for.

retroactive.description: Retroactive toggle for defaults (re-resolve history when true).

source_id.description: Source to prefer for this metric.

needs_setup.description: True when no account exists yet → the setup wizard should run.

SourceDto.description: A data source (device/provider) as exposed to the client.

created_at.description: First time we saw this source.

SourceKind.description: Broad kind of data origin. Hardware specifics live in Gadgetbridge, not here.

Sport.description:
Sport / activity type. Kept coarse on purpose — fine-grained typing is a
presentation concern, while dedup clustering only needs the broad category.

StreamKind.description:
The metric a stream carries. This enum is also the granularity at which
per-metric source preferences resolve (see [`crate::preference`]).

TrackPoint.description: A geographic point for the map track.

WellnessKind.description:
The kind of continuous wellness metric a sample carries.

Each variant maps to a scalar `value` in [`WellnessSample`]; categorical
kinds (sleep stage) encode via a stable numeric code, keeping the hot path
a single numeric column for high-rate streaming.

value.description: Value (categorical kinds use a stable numeric code).

points.description: Trend samples, ascending by time (may be empty for this dataset).
